import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Calculate total sales contribution by product
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.barplot(x=product_sales.index, y=product_sales.values, palette='viridis')
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')
plt.title('Top 10 Products by Total Sales Revenue', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Product Type', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
